title: schmaltzia tepetate
intro: Schmaltzia tepetate, commonly known as "tepetate" or "Copal", is a type of tree resin extracted from the Schmaltzia schipifolia tree. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schmaltzia tepetate include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for skin and soft tissue injuries. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
